# agy-swap

> High-Performance Native Account Switcher and Real-Time Quota Monitor for Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`). Built in Go with sub-millisecond execution and zero external dependencies.

- **Website**: https://agy-swap.aklkbqx.com/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aklkbqx/agy-swap
- **License**: MIT
- **Platforms**: macOS (arm64/x86_64), Linux (arm64/x86_64), Windows (arm64/x86_64)

## Core Capabilities
- **Transactional Account Switching**: Instant switching between Google Antigravity developer accounts with automatic rollback protection.
- **Real-Time Quota & Cooldowns**: Proactive tracking of Gemini and third-party model limits, reset timers, and remaining capacity.
- **Native OS Vault**: Hardware-backed token storage in macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, and Linux Secret Service.
- **Interactive TUI & Command Palette**: Adaptive terminal interface with fast keyboard navigation (`Ctrl-K` / `:`).
- **Diagnostics**: Built-in `agy-swap doctor` health check for permissions, OAuth tokens, and network endpoints.

## Installation
- **macOS Homebrew**: `brew install aklkbqx/agy-swap/agy-swap`
- **macOS / Linux**: `curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aklkbqx/agy-swap/main/install.sh | bash`
- **Windows PowerShell**: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aklkbqx/agy-swap/main/install.ps1 | iex`

## CLI Quick Reference
- `agy-swap` (Launch interactive TUI)
- `agy-swap add` (Interactive OAuth login)
- `agy-swap list` (List accounts and quota)
- `agy-swap switch <email|index>` (Switch active session)
- `agy-swap next` (Rotate to next available account)
- `agy-swap limits` (Show quota breakdown)
- `agy-swap doctor` (Run system diagnostic checks)
